graphFrame.autoImputeOn: Auto-impute relationships is on. Click to disable.
graphFrame.groupTooltip: Group nodes by attribute (double-click a hull to collapse; double-click collapsed node to expand)
graphFrame.firstNodesShown: Showing the first {{count}} nodes; there are more. Raise the limit in the side menu.
graphFrame.sparqlDropForm: A pill can't be dropped on a {{form}} result: it takes a SELECT or a CONSTRUCT. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropUnion: A pill can't be dropped on a UNION query: it can't say which side to join. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropGroupBy: A pill can't be dropped on a GROUP BY query: its rows are groups, not resources. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropAggregate: A pill can't be dropped on an aggregate query: its rows are totals, not resources. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropSubquery: A pill can't be dropped on a query with a sub-SELECT. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropNoClass: This result names no class to join to: give a variable a class, then drop again. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropNode: That node is no variable of this query, so there is nothing to join it to. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropNoPath: {{name}} has no relationship to {{classes}}. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropTooFar: {{name}} is {{hops}} relationships from {{classes}}, past the {{most}} a drop walks: no short path. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropNoEnd: Neither end of {{name}} is in this result. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropParameterized: A path can't go through {{name}}: it takes arguments to read. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropEdgeParameterized: {{name}} leads to a table that takes arguments to read, and a path can't go through one. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropNoProperty: No class in this result has {{name}}. Nothing was added.
graphFrame.sparqlDropLeftOut: Added {{shown}} of {{total}} equally short paths; the others were left out.
graphFrame.sparqlDropCut: The result reached its LIMIT of {{limit}}: rows past it are left out.
graphFrame.cypherPathNoKey: The paths between {{from}} and {{to}} need each node's key, and one of them has none.
